Group Notes: Pick up rental cars in the morning and take E16 out of Oslo, transitioning to Rv7 past Hønefoss and Rv52 at Gol over Hemsedalsfjellet. Great food and drink stops along the route include Bryggerihuset in Gol (gourmet smash burgers and Gøtt craft beer), Hemsedal Café (mountain trout and lamb), Laksen Bakeri in Lærdalsøyri, and the Sogn organic farm shop in Aurland.
